title: A revert's bug can name a job whose retry passed, so its --job repro is green at once
goal: ql_deliver.pipeline_failure and backlog.red_detail pick the failed job from each job's newest attempt (ql_deliver.latest_jobs), so a job retried to success is not named in a bug's repro; a test plants a failed attempt followed by a passing retry. From the SP-z7a5c76b review.
